Description
Aparthotel Adagio London City East
Apartment
Your London getaway starts in Whitechapel! Settle into one of the 132 modern apartments at Adagio London City East and enjoy a fully equipped kitchen, a comfortable living area and a workspace designed to make you feel at home. Between exploring London’s highlights, unwind in your apartment or keep active in the fitness centre. Breakfast, a 24/7 reception, laundry facilities and a shop are also available, giving you everything you need for a comfortable and flexible stay.
Whether you’re travelling alone, as a couple, with family or friends, Aparthotel Adagio London City East offers studios and apartments with 1 to 4 bedrooms, accommodating up to 8 guests. Accessible apartments, private parking and pet-friendly accommodation ensure a flexible and comfortable stay in London.
Located in Whitechapel, the Aparthotel Adagio London City East allows you to discover London on foot, between the Tower of London, Tower Bridge, Brick Lane and the markets of Spitalfields, with quick access to the metro to explore the capital.
A very warm welcome to Adagio London City East! Immerse yourself with the unique experience in the heart of London where you will discover the finest attractions, such as Tower Bridge, Brick Lane and more just moments away. Satyam Talwar, Hotel Management Mr. Satyam TALWAR, Hotel Management See more Aparthotel Adagio London City East
Hotel information
Breakfast is free of charge for children under 12 years old (subject to one paying breakfast per apartment).
Hotel extras
Central location, with plenty of nearby transport links
5 minute walk to Aldgate East and Whitechapel tube station
Unlimited English buffet breakfast available
Old Spitalfields Market is just a ten minute walk away
Plenty of restaurants and bars located nearby

Customer review rating 4.5/5
Frank G. Families
- 11/4/2026 Confirmed reviews ALL
We had a wonderful stay at Aparthotel Adagio London City East.
The staff is extremely friendly and helpful. Although our 4-person room was on the smaller side, it was very cleverly laid out and exceptionally well-equipped with everything we needed. The room was perfectly clean and the beds were very comfortable, ensuring a great night's sleep. Another big plus was how quiet the room was—despite hearing plenty of sirens outside throughout the day and night, we weren't bothered by the noise at all inside.
The breakfast was really good and tasty. The breakfast room is a bit small, so we had to wait briefly for a table on a couple of occasions, but that certainly didn't spoil our experience.
The location is ideal: very central and easily accessible by public transport, with bus and tube stations right around the corner.
We highly recommend this hotel and would definitely love to stay here again! See more See more about the review from Frank G.
Our hotel has responded to the review Our hotel has responded to the review from Frank G.
Dear Frank G.,
Thank you for taking the time to share your positive experience at Aparthotel Adagio London City East.
We are delighted to hear that you enjoyed our central location and found our staff to be friendly and helpful. It is gratifying to know that the layout and cleanliness of your room contributed to a comfortable stay, and that you appreciated the quiet atmosphere despite the bustling city outside.
We also value your feedback regarding the breakfast room. We strive to provide a pleasant dining experience and acknowledge that during busy times, seating may be limited. Your understanding in this matter is greatly appreciated.
We are thrilled to learn that you would recommend our hotel and look forward to welcoming you back on your next visit.
Sincerely,
Lakshay Khurana
Front Office Manager
